content.text: The app runs correctly and prints the Lombok-generated `toString()` output.

Set up a Maven project (`com.example:app`) with Lombok 1.18.38 wired in via `pom.xml` (dependency + annotation processor path for the compiler plugin) and JUnit 5 for tests:

- `pom.xml` — Lombok as `provided`, JUnit Jupiter for testing, compiler/surefire plugins configured for Java 17.
- `src/main/java/com/example/app/User.java` — sample model using `@Data`, `@NoArgsConstructor`, `@AllArgsConstructor` to eliminate manual getters/setters/constructors/equals/hashCode/toString.
- `src/main/java/com/example/app/App.java` — entry point demonstrating the generated constructor/`toString`.
- `src/test/java/com/example/app/UserTest.java` — verifies generated getters/setters and `equals`.

Verified with `mvn test` (passes) and running `App` (prints `User(name=Ada Lovelace, email=ada@example.com, age=30)`), confirming Lombok's annotation processing works end to end.
